sections.title: MAMAMOO — Mr-Ambiguous
sections.content:
In this lesson, we'll learn words related to mixed signals, sseom frustration, wanting commitment.
Grammar: -지 말고 -아/어 봐 ('Don't do X, try Y instead.' 찔러보지만 말고 저질러봐 and 내숭떨)

sections.title: About this song
sections.content: Mr. Ambiguous is a cabaret-flavored complaint about a guy who won't commit to sending a clear signal one way or another — flirty enough to keep her hooked, distant enough that she can't be sure of any...

sections.title: 패턴을 찾아봐요
sections.content: 'Don't do X, try Y instead.' 찔러보지만 말고 저질러봐 and 내숭떨지 말고 가져봐 both use this pattern to redirect hesitant behavior into direct action.
